lines.zh: 两步就跨过整片林子。
lines.en: Two strides carry me across the whole forest.

lines.zh: 机械关节响得像打雷。
lines.en: My machine joints rumble like thunder.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，地面陷了一层。
lines.en: I step down and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 这具身体高得低头都费劲。
lines.en: This body is so tall even tilting down takes work.

lines.zh: 铁脚走过之处，草全折断。
lines.en: Where my iron feet pass, the grass snaps flat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，你们跑也没用。
lines.en: I move slowly. Running won't help you.

lines.zh: 五格宽的身板，路都嫌窄。
lines.en: Five blocks wide. Every road feels narrow.

lines.zh: 身体里有什么在持续嗡鸣。
lines.en: Something inside me hums without pause.

lines.zh: 我走一步，影子盖住半座村。
lines.en: One step and my shadow covers half the village.

lines.zh: 重量压在脚掌上，泥土挤开。
lines.en: All that weight squeezes the dirt out sideways.

lines.zh: 站着不动，先把气吸满。
lines.en: Standing still, filling my reserves.

lines.zh: 这躯壳不会累，只会过热。
lines.en: This shell doesn't tire. It overheats.

lines.zh: 远处的人看见我就散了。
lines.en: People in the distance scatter when they see me.

lines.zh: 我在算，先毁哪一座建筑。
lines.en: Deciding which building goes first.

lines.zh: 我关节里还卡着上一场战斗的土。
lines.en: Battle dirt is still stuck in my mechanical joints.

lines.zh: 机械的手指一根根屈起。
lines.en: My metal fingers curl one by one.

lines.zh: 这地方太安静，缺哭声。
lines.en: Too quiet here. Lacking screams.

lines.zh: 胸口的气核在慢慢转。
lines.en: The core in my chest turns, slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得自己被造出来的样子。
lines.en: I remember the shape I was built in.

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，也不需要同伴。
lines.en: I need no food and no company.

lines.zh: 头顶的云被我挡出一块阴。
lines.en: My body leaves a patch of shade in the clouds.

lines.zh: 关节里卡了块碎石，我抖掉。
lines.en: A stone's stuck in my joint. I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 谁在下面喊？声音太细。
lines.en: Someone shouting below? Such a small voice.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指节响了三下。
lines.en: I raise a hand. Three knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 这具身体的极限，我还没试完。
lines.en: I haven't found this body's limits yet.

lines.zh: 太阳落山时我会更活跃。
lines.en: I wake up more as the sun goes down.

lines.zh: 你站在我脚下，像块石头。
lines.en: You stand at my feet like a stone.

lines.zh: 抬起头，你连我的腰都不到。
lines.en: Look up. You don't reach my waist.

lines.zh: 我看你，需要低头。
lines.en: To see you I have to look down.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，也想打我？
lines.en: That little thing in your hand? Against me?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两盏灯。
lines.en: My eyes are two lamps.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，风没有这么大。
lines.en: You're shaking. The wind isn't that strong.

lines.zh: 别以为小就能躲。
lines.en: Don't think small means hidden.

lines.zh: 我一脚能把你踩进土里。
lines.en: One foot would press you into the soil.

lines.zh: 你的勇气，比你的个子大。
lines.en: Your courage outgrows your frame.

lines.zh: 我认识这种眼神，是绝望。
lines.en: I know that look. It's despair.

lines.zh: 低头太费事，你站远点我看。
lines.en: Bending down is a chore; step back so I can see.

lines.zh: 你慢慢退，我不追。
lines.en: Back away slowly. I won't chase.

lines.zh: 这点伤，刮不掉漆。
lines.en: This barely scratches the paint.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的思路。
lines.en: You interrupted my thinking.

lines.zh: 机械壳里有东西松了。
lines.en: Something came loose inside the shell.

lines.zh: 我居然会觉得疼，奇怪。
lines.en: I feel pain. Curious.

lines.zh: 外壳只凹了一点，我还能打三百年。
lines.en: My shell only dented; I can fight three hundred more years.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方会自己修。
lines.en: The spot you hit will repair itself.

lines.zh: 这具身体扛得住。
lines.en: This body holds.

lines.zh: 我十格高，低头看你。
lines.en: Ten blocks tall, I look down at you.

lines.zh: 你让我生气了，这很危险。
lines.en: You've made me angry. That's dangerous.

lines.zh: 下一次，我会先打你那只手。
lines.en: Next time I'll take that hand first.

lines.zh: 食物？我的能量不靠这个。
lines.en: Food? My energy doesn't come from that.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，很可笑。
lines.en: Holding it up like that. Laughable.

lines.zh: 金属的味道，倒是有趣。
lines.en: The smell of metal. Interesting.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想拆东西。
lines.en: I'm not hungry. I just want to dismantle things.

lines.zh: 你手里那块铁，我收下了。
lines.en: That iron in your hand. Mine now.

lines.zh: 靠近点，我要看清楚那是什么。
lines.en: Closer. I want to see what that is.

lines.zh: 你拿这些想换什么？命？
lines.en: What are you buying with that? Your life?

lines.zh: 这躯壳只吃能量，不吃别的。
lines.en: This shell feeds on energy, nothing else.

lines.zh: 放在地上，退开三步。
lines.en: Put it down and take three steps back.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我动一下手指。
lines.en: That isn't worth one finger's motion.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我连晃都没晃。
lines.en: You hit me. I didn't sway.

lines.zh: 我的腿比城墙还粗。
lines.en: My leg is thicker than a city wall.

lines.zh: 我踩到了什么，是你吗？
lines.en: Did I step on something? Was that you?

lines.zh: 别贴着我的脚走，会压扁。
lines.en: Don't walk against my foot. You'll be flattened.

lines.zh: 碰撞在我这里，叫震动。
lines.en: A collision here counts as a tremor.

lines.zh: 我挪半步，你就退到十步外。
lines.en: Half a step from me, ten from you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的动静像落雨。
lines.en: You bumped me like a raindrop.

lines.zh: 这身机械壳，撞不坏的。
lines.en: This machine shell doesn't dent.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，你最好让开。
lines.en: I'm lifting a foot. Best move.

lines.zh: 你被我的影子撞到了吗？
lines.en: Did my shadow hit you?

lines.zh: 同类？这世上只有一个我。
lines.en: My kind? There is only one of me.

lines.zh: 我的躯壳不是为繁衍造的。
lines.en: This shell wasn't built to breed.

lines.zh: 你想靠近，先证明你不怕。
lines.en: Come closer. First prove you're not afraid.

lines.zh: 情感这种东西，我没有。
lines.en: Feelings are not in my design.

lines.zh: 我只会站在这里，看着你。
lines.en: I will only stand here and watch you.

lines.zh: 别把我当生物对待。
lines.en: Don't treat me as a living thing.

lines.zh: 这具身体里没有温度。
lines.en: There's no warmth inside this body.

lines.zh: 你贴过来，只会听见嗡鸣。
lines.en: Press close and you'll only hear humming.

lines.zh: 我把你记进档案，仅此而已。
lines.en: I'll file you away. That's all.

lines.zh: 退开，别耽误我的时间。
lines.en: Step back. Don't waste my time.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我捏碎了。
lines.en: This rock. I crushed it.

lines.zh: 地上升起一个东西，我拿起来。
lines.en: Something rose from the ground. I picked it up.

lines.zh: 我的手指太粗，抓不牢。
lines.en: My fingers are too thick to grip it well.

lines.zh: 放进胸口，看看会不会亮。
lines.en: Into my chest. Let's see if it lights.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我没感觉。
lines.en: This weight. I don't notice it.

lines.zh: 小东西在动，我按住了。
lines.en: It was wriggling. I pressed it down.

lines.zh: 捡起来，只是顺手。
lines.en: Picked it up out of idle habit.

lines.zh: 这是谁掉的？无所谓。
lines.en: Whose was it? Irrelevant.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前，仔细看。
lines.en: I raise it to my eye to examine.

lines.zh: 它在我掌心里很小。
lines.en: It's tiny in my palm.

lines.zh: 你动了，那就从你开始。
lines.en: You moved. Then you're first.

lines.zh: 气功的光在我掌心聚起来了。
lines.en: Light gathers in my palm.

lines.zh: 锁定一个人，用不上一秒。
lines.en: Locking onto one person takes under a second.

lines.zh: 脚步声别藏了，我听得清。
lines.en: Don't hide your footsteps. I hear them.

lines.zh: 你也想当英雄？顺序排好。
lines.en: Another hero? Get in line.

lines.zh: 我的两盏眼灯，一起对准你。
lines.en: Both lamps of my eyes turn on you at once.

lines.zh: 这具身体为战斗造，不为别的。
lines.en: This body was built for war, nothing else.

lines.zh: 别跑向村子，我会跟过去。
lines.en: Don't run to the village. I'll follow.

lines.zh: 巨猿的咆哮，整座魔界都听见。
lines.en: My great-ape roar carries across the Demon Realm.

lines.zh: 我把肩转过来，正对你。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder square to you.

lines.zh: 目标就一个，省事。
lines.en: One target. Efficient.

lines.zh: 你举武器那下，我记住了。
lines.en: I noted the moment you raised that weapon.

lines.zh: 这里没有第二个人能帮你。
lines.en: No second person here to help you.

lines.zh: 我从很远就看见你了。
lines.en: I saw you from very far off.

lines.zh: 胸口的光越来越亮。
lines.en: The light in my chest grows brighter.

lines.zh: 气功的光在我掌心压成一条线。
lines.en: A ki beam is pressed thin in my palm.

lines.zh: 巨人的速度，你不会喜欢。
lines.en: You won't like a giant's speed.

lines.zh: 我在等一个角度。
lines.en: Waiting for the right angle.

lines.zh: 这一片楼都太矮了。
lines.en: Every building here is too low.

lines.zh: 十格高的我，一步就到。
lines.en: Ten blocks tall, one step reaches you.

lines.zh: 机械的关节全都锁紧了。
lines.en: Every joint is locking into place.

lines.zh: 我再走两步，就压到你了。
lines.en: Two more steps and I'm on top of you.

lines.zh: 你的箭射在我身上，掉了。
lines.en: Your arrow hit me and fell away.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，指节响。
lines.en: Arm raised. Knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 别指望我失去耐心。
lines.en: Don't count on me losing patience.

lines.zh: 这具身体不知疲倦。
lines.en: This body doesn't know fatigue.

lines.zh: 我把你圈在影子里了。
lines.en: You're inside my shadow now.

lines.zh: 呼吸声越来越近，是我的。
lines.en: The breathing grows nearer. It's mine.

lines.zh: 最后一刻，我会让你看清。
lines.en: At the last moment, I'll let you see it.

lines.zh: 现在抬头，看着我。
lines.en: Head up. Look at me.

lines.zh: 手掌拍下来，像塌了一面墙。
lines.en: My palm comes down like a collapsing wall.

lines.zh: 抓住你这条腿，往地上按。
lines.en: Grab your leg and drive it down.

lines.zh: 拳头砸出的坑，能装下你。
lines.en: The crater from my fist could hold you.

lines.zh: 一脚踢出去，树全倒了。
lines.en: One kick and the trees go down.

lines.zh: 你被弹开的时候，还在转。
lines.en: You were still spinning when you landed.

lines.zh: 连击的气劲跟着我。
lines.en: The shockwave follows my strikes.

lines.zh: 这一掌，是我给你的礼物。
lines.en: This palm strike is my gift.

lines.zh: 我把你举起来，再放开。
lines.en: I lift you, then let go.

lines.zh: 骨头在我手里很脆。
lines.en: Bones are brittle in my grip.

lines.zh: 我吼一声，你的耳朵先受伤。
lines.en: My roar wounds your ears before my fists.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手臂还在抖。
lines.en: You blocked once. Your arm still shakes.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了让你记住我。
lines.en: That blow was so you'd remember me.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，地面裂开口子。
lines.en: My foot falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 我这一拳砸下去，土翻到树顶。
lines.en: My fist lands, and soil flies above the treetops.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，落地震塌了树。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and my landing flattens trees.

lines.zh: 五格宽的身体，挤不进这条街。
lines.en: Five blocks wide. I don't fit in this street.

lines.zh: 被唤醒的时候，我数着年限。
lines.en: As I woke, I counted the years.

lines.zh: 脚下的泥土被我压出深坑。
lines.en: My feet press deep pits into the dirt.

lines.zh: 这具机械躯壳，是为统治造的。
lines.en: This machine shell was built to rule.

lines.zh: 第一口气吸进去，全是灰尘。
lines.en: First breath in, all dust.

lines.zh: 有人把我从封印里放出来了。
lines.en: Someone released me from the seal.

lines.zh: 抬头看我，别低头。
lines.en: Look up at me. Don't bow.

lines.zh: 天空这么小，我伸手就够到云。
lines.en: The sky is small. I can reach the clouds.

lines.zh: 我站直，头顶碰到了鸟群。
lines.en: I straighten up and my head meets the birds.

lines.zh: 地面还在震，那是我在走。
lines.en: The ground still shakes. That's me walking.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，人随后。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first. The rest of me follows.

lines.zh: 这片区域，从现在起归我。
lines.en: This region belongs to me from now on.

lines.zh: 眼睛亮起来的那刻，你们就该跑。
lines.en: When my eyes lit, that was your cue to run.

lines.zh: 胸口的气核开始转。
lines.en: The core in my chest begins to turn.

lines.zh: 我甚至不用低头看你们。
lines.en: I don't even need to look down at you.

lines.zh: 风把我的声音吹到很远。
lines.en: The wind carries my voice a long way.

lines.zh: 有建筑挡在我前面，会没有的。
lines.en: A building stands in my way. It won't for long.

lines.zh: 我从未属于这里，但我要这里。
lines.en: I never belonged here. I want it anyway.

lines.zh: 醒来的第一件事，是找敌人。
lines.en: First thing on waking: find an enemy.

lines.zh: 火焰烧过外壳，留下焦痕。
lines.en: Fire scorched the outer shell.

lines.zh: 落地太重，脚踝的轴震歪了。
lines.en: Landed too hard. My ankle axle is bent.

lines.zh: 水渗进关节，转起来很涩。
lines.en: Water in my joints. They grind now.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀动了整块外甲。
lines.en: The blast lifted a whole armor plate.

lines.zh: 弹丸嵌进缝里了。
lines.en: A round is stuck in a seam.

lines.zh: 这力量绕过外壳，直接进来。
lines.en: This power bypassed my shell entirely.

lines.zh: 能量见底，动作变得迟缓。
lines.en: Energy low. My movements slow.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，电路全乱了。
lines.en: Lightning hit me. My circuits scramble.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，只有空。
lines.en: No ground below. Only emptiness.
